answer: Graph-distance bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and registers one vertex in the atlas against forgery. Its vertex needs links to five established vertices three or more apart; farm vertices cluster and fail. Each epoch the beacon names an audit vertex; dead links burn the bond. A fake costs 155 (70 bond, 45 fee, five 8-credit links): 1,000 fakes cost 155,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 115 once and keep their reward.
